profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at AAA Life Insurance Company
profile.summary:
I'm a dedicated, versatile IT developer and project / program manager with more than 20 years of experience delivering creative technology solutions across multiple platforms. My skill set combines technical strengths with a natural ability to build strong, collaborative relationships; I'm comfortable and confident serving as a liaison between technical teams and clients.

Those with whom I work appreciate my problem solving capabilities; I have a reputation for  identifying areas for improvement and streamlining processes to hit (or surpass) key business or team goals. I'm also quick to learn new technologies and products, and can effectively translate this information to accommodate the sophistication level of the end user.

I enjoy leading and educating others, and am considered both a mentor and a “go to” resource based on my broad knowledge base and commitment to designing first-class IT solutions.

I welcome you to contact me directly at gregality@yahoo.com.

positions.title: Software Development Manager
positions.description: Note: Morpace and Market Strategies Inc. merged in June 2018 and rebranded as Escalent.

positions.title: Technical Project Lead
positions.description: Manage and coordinate technical resources and assets and direct design and development of systems-level architecture. Work on custom solutions involving integrating IBM SPSS Data Collection with internal processes.  Automate and streamline existing systems and providing technical expertise and resource management on larger projects.

positions.title: Senior Systems Programmer, Systems
positions.description:
Programming aptitude and solutions-based focus led to role as a senior systems programmer for this internationally recognized market research firm. Manage the design, development and documentation of new applications used to collect and process survey data for a variety of industries. 

Leverage problem-solving talents to identify areas for improvement in quality and efficiency within the Data Processing department. Using C#, ASP.NET, Perl and SQL Server applications, have optimized numerous call center reports – linking a variety of MSI’s systems.

Key Accomplishments: 

 Led a cross-functional team tasked with developing content and tools for a program that captures feedback used in performance evaluations. Provided architecture on all applications and database structures that successfully integrated multiple internal systems.
 
 Proactively tackled a high-profile project using .NET and a customizable XML configuration to track and enable the entry of chart/diary information on multiple traditional surveys. The application has been in near continuous use since 2007.

 Created a custom ETL process integrating web and non-web applications that continuously load metadata and case data for 150-250 active projects. This process moves information from a data collection platform directly into client-facing online portals, providing a robust means of accessing real-time data / information.

 Led the migration of processes and data for a $9M business unit to a customized solution in Microsoft CRM. Completed the project on-time and 25% under budget.

positions.title: Systems Programmer, Systems
positions.description:
Promoted into a systems programmer role, writing and maintaining applications for a client-facing reporting tool that hosted 4,000+ projects.  Also delivered 24/7 support for online data collection systems.

Key Accomplishments: 

• Applied process improvement insights into improving complex, Excel-based reports that included statistical significance testing and custom indexes.

• Served as the key designer and developer of MSI’s Case Tracking System, integrating a variety of survey applications from Windows/Unix platforms to SQL Server using stored procedures, triggers, Perl and batch processes.

positions.title: Data Analyst/Programmer, Data Processing
positions.description:
Recruited to join MSI as an analyst/programmer, with primary responsibility of programming survey scripts for telephone and web-based interviewing.

Key Accomplishments: 

• Generated data tabulations with statistical tests and applied weighting schemes as necessary. Built command-line utilities that automated repetitive tasks in the data delivery process.

• A skilled mentor, was chosen to train staff on survey data collection, analysis and reporting processes.
